texts.label: text
texts.orig: A service that lets you text a pediatrician any day or night with random questions and get an answer within 15 minutes. We’ve used it to settle disagreements about hand washing, to check to make sure we didn’t ruin the baby when our dog knocked a heavy water bottle onto his noggin, and whether his eye goop was normal (it was). It’s so much more convenient (and quicker) than asking our actual pediatrician questions, and it’s nice to get a second “It’s OK.” The team at Summer Health gave me a 20% coupon code to share: LENNY20.
